threshold_source_note: v8.12: ForgeBlock own static model (MobileNetV3-Large Siamese/triplet, trained on own 55-participant dataset, round 1 of 5, test participants [4, 6, 18, 30, 32, 34, 38, 39, 41, 52, 55] never seen). Default thresholds = EER point on those unseen participants (used with fewer than 7 references). Bounds = 1st-99th percentile of the adaptive thresholds of all 55 participants when unseen, widened.
